notes: Locke is not a champion I can verify outside this brief, so I stayed strictly inside the kit file and the missingInteractions headlines. Two things I could NOT verify and therefore did not touch: (1) the Q is called 'Ritual Nails' across the whole page, but the kit text only names the projectiles 'Soul Nails' and packet.enemyAbilities is null — the missingInteractions headlines confirm Silver Stake (P), Soul Ignition (W) and Ashen Pursuit (E), but never name the Q, so I left 'Ritual Nails' alone rather than guess. (2) The page asserts Kayle's R denies the execute. Riot's text for Divine Judgment says invulnerable; the kit's derived flag says untargetable. Those are different things, and report[8] leans specifically on untargetability ('untargetable at the floor = execute denied') — if the R is invulnerability rather than untargetability, that reasoning may not transfer from a Zhonya's-class item. I left the claim in place because it is the user's existing text and I cannot settle it from Riot's description. Also worth a look: this lane is 46.06% over 406 games but is labelled EVEN at difficulty 5.5/10 with the packet chart giving Skill on six of seven rows. The full layer's hand-written phases already tell a losing story. Flagging rather than flipping, since the chart change would be a six-row rewrite on my judgement alone.
